# Supertonic browser inference helper

`supertonicHelper.js` is copied from the archived upstream browser example at
`https://github.com/supertone-oss-archive/supertonic/blob/main/web/helper.js`.
The source is MIT licensed; see `SUPERTONIC_LICENSE.txt`.

Model weights are fetched on demand from `supertone-oss-archive/supertonic-3`
at revision `aafc6e32416a594460b32413efc49d7fe4ce6d46` and are licensed
under OpenRAIL-M. The model weights are not redistributed in this repository.
The five SoriON persona mappings are approximations, not the original voice identities.
